criteria: Inspect owner omarchy-nts-radio reference and document its actual NTS live stream URLs, playback backend and relevant failure/recovery handling.
Establish a bounded NTS1/2 in-app playback experiment and justified finite stream/redirect/CSP policy using actual primary-source and runtime evidence, preserving clean UI and playback coordination.

Independently Review and Verify any implemented exact candidate, separating direct HTTP/browser checks from actual ChatGPT audible Play/Pause/resume and host CSP evidence; missing host evidence stays BLOCKED.

events.title: Prove NTS in-app playback using Omarchy reference

objective: Use owner omarchy-nts-radio repo as read-only reference to enable NTS1/2 playback in Dial through a focused compatibility experiment; no proxy or broad policy change without concrete reviewed design.

reports.complexity: MEDIUM: route behavior is bounded and simple to probe, but a useful playback candidate needs a browser audio experiment, exact CSP/origin behavior, clean failure UX, coordination and actual host evidence.
evidence: Read-only reference inspection found no AGENTS.md in the reference repo file inventory. Model.js documents official relay URLs without ?client=direct and a redirect-following mpv design; Player.qml implements one live audio backend with error reporting and retry behavior.

Primary source: NTS Support, TuneIn article modified 2025-10-15, lists NTS1 https://stream-relay-geo.ntslive.net/stream?client=direct and NTS2 https://stream-relay-geo.ntslive.net/stream2?client=direct as live stream links: https://ntslive.freshdesk.com/support/solutions/articles/77000587257-tunein

On 2026-11-12 from this shell network vantage, a bounded Node fetch used redirect:manual, Range bytes=0-63, 8-second timeout per hop and maximum five hops. All four endpoints (both channels with and without ?client=direct) returned the same shape: relay 302 -> https://streams.radiomast.io/nts1 or /nts2 (302) -> https://audio-edge-kkqan.sin.d.radiomast.io/nts1 or /nts2 (200 audio/mpeg). This is direct HTTP route evidence only, one vantage/time; no bytes were consumed/decoded and it does not prove browser playback.

Local Chromium is installed. A bounded headless audio-element dump-dom experiment did not return output within 30 seconds; no browser media result is claimed. No ChatGPT host/CSP/audible playback result was obtained.
open_questions: Can ChatGPT MCP Apps audio playback follow the official relay redirect under a finite and supportable resourceDomains/CSP policy for both channels?
Does a bounded NTS-specific route through the stable relay and streams.radiomast.io work without admitting arbitrary dynamic edge origins, or is a narrowly scoped intermediary needed?
What are the actual host results for Play, Pause, resume, error presentation, and playback persistence/coordination?
relevant_code: /home/sam/omarchy-nts-radio-audio-handoff/Model.js: STREAM_ENDPOINTS defines https://stream-relay-geo.ntslive.net/stream and /stream2 without query parameters; comments say mpv follows the geo relay redirect so hosts can move.

/home/sam/omarchy-nts-radio-audio-handoff/Player.qml: single mpv child process handles live audio, IPC pause/volume state, stream switching and live rejoin; process stderr/exit populate a user-facing error and live failures retry with capped exponential backoff (5s × 3^retryCount, max 60s).
factory/work-items/DIAL-009/TECH.md: approved prior gate keeps NTS link-only pending a finite redirect route and real ChatGPT host CSP/audio checks; current implementation has no NTS media admission.
factory/work-items/DIAL-009/evidence/run-77886707bfd8/verification.md: DIAL-009 independent Verify states ChatGPT host audio/CSP/layout/Pause/resume evidence is unavailable and BLOCKED.
risks: The redirect edge hostname is dynamic by design according to the reference's mpv comments; one observed edge hostname cannot safely be treated as durable.
CSP may reject a redirect destination even when the official relay is admitted; this shell probe does not model MCP Apps CSP or host sandboxing.
Desktop mpv success or raw audio/mpeg HTTP response cannot establish ChatGPT audio-element Play/Pause/resume, audible output, persistence, or coordination.
Broad wildcard Radiomast media permission would expand policy beyond NTS; any necessary broader surface needs an explicit, reviewed NTS-specific route design and clean failure fallback.
reports.scope: Read-only triage of the owner-provided Omarchy NTS client and prior DIAL-009 NTS gate; bounded redirect route probe for NTS1/2, with assessment of browser and ChatGPT playback evidence. No repository files changed.

evidence: Owner reference read-only: Model.js defines https://stream-relay-geo.ntslive.net/stream and /stream2; Player.qml uses a single redirect-following mpv backend with error state and capped live reconnection.
NTS primary source https://ntslive.freshdesk.com/support/solutions/articles/77000587257-tunein lists the same channel paths with ?client=direct as its published custom-player URLs.
Triage's 2026-11-12 bounded direct HTTP route probe observed relay 302 -> streams.radiomast.io 302 -> audio-edge-kkqan.sin.d.radiomast.io 200 audio/mpeg for both channels.

Spec independently repeated both routes at 2026-11-12 08:29 UTC from the same shell/network vantage with manual redirects, a five-hop cap, Range bytes=0-63, and an eight-second per-hop deadline; both again returned the same three-hop route and final 200 audio/mpeg. No audio bytes were decoded or heard.

Current DIAL-009 code has NTS link-only UI in public/discovery.html and src/player.ts, one audio element/controller/coordinator, and finite CSP in src/server.ts. DIAL-009 Verify recorded real ChatGPT host audio/CSP as BLOCKED.
reports.owner_review: Approve the exact PRODUCT.md and TECH.md hashes before build. This spec permits experimental Play in the existing NTS panel with only three observed NTS CSP origins, explicitly superseding DIAL-009's pre-enable host-proof gate for this experiment. Host audible Play/Pause/Play-again and CSP must be independently tested after an authorized connection; missing evidence remains BLOCKED. No production files changed, merged, or deployed.
